## What

An AXI-Stream frame path in the fabric that adds a **per-frame header and CRC**
and leaves a slot where the compressor will go. Test it with the B1.3 replayed
passes so it does not wait on B2.2.

```
AXI DMA MM2S -> [ header ] -> [ compressor slot: pass-through for now ] -> [ CRC ] -> AXI DMA S2MM
```

## Done when

- [ ] CRC checked on **every frame of a 2-minute pass**.
- [ ] The header format (sequence number, timestamp, length, flags) is
      documented in `docs/FRAME_FORMAT.md`.
- [ ] Each module has a cocotb bench, including a malformed or truncated frame
      and backpressure from the downstream side.

## Carries over

- `_superseded/CMP-04-packet-framing.md`: the CRC and framing work.
- `_superseded/DP-05-input-cdc-fifo.md`: overflow telemetry on any FIFO (use
  `xpm_fifo_axis` rather than a hand-written FIFO).
- `_superseded/DP-04-framer-unpacker.md`: 14-bit samples already arrive in
  2 B, so no unpacker is needed; keep the framing checks.
